zweirad mechaniker

Stellenbeschreibung:
We are partnering with a fast-growing e-mobility startup to recruit a Team Lead – E-Bike Mechanics for their Berlin Refurbishment Centre.
In this role, you will lead and mentor a team of e-bike mechanics, ensuring the highest quality standards in e-bike refurbishment and repair. You’ll play a key part in ensuring operations run smoothly and efficiently while promoting a positive team culture. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of sustainable mobility in one of the most dynamic sectors.

Your Role

- Lead & Mentor: Provide hands-on guidance and training to a team of e-bike mechanics, ensuring their continuous development and high performance.
- Technical Expertise: Act as the go-to expert for complex repairs and troubleshooting, setting the benchmark for technical excellence.
- Workflow & Efficiency: Oversee day-to-day operations, optimizing processes to ensure efficiency, productivity, and adherence to timelines.
- Quality Control: Ensure that all refurbished e-bikes meet rigorous quality standards before reaching customers.
- Problem Solving & Innovation: Identify bottlenecks in operations and implement process improvements to enhance performance and customer satisfaction.
- Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Operations, Customer Service) to streamline operations and enhance service delivery.
- Health & Safety Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and best practices are followed, maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

Your Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in e-bike mechanics, with extensive hands-on experience.
- Previous team management experience with a proven track record of mentoring and developing team members.
- Strong diagnostic and repair skills across a wide range of e-bike brands and models.
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Passion for sustainable mobility and a customer-first mindset.
- Basic PC skills (Email, MS Office).
- Good knowledge of English (German is a plus).
- Willingness to work in a team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The Offer

- High-impact role with responsibility for leading and mentoring a talented team of mechanics.
- Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art tools and diagnostic equipment in a comfortable environment.
- Career development opportunities with performance evaluations and the chance for promotion every six months.
- Work with a diverse range of e-bikes—gain expertise in different bike types, models, and brands.
- Competitive salary with benefits.
- No weekend work, providing you with a great work-life balance.
- Be part of a fast-growing startup in the sustainable e-mobility sector, with a mission-driven focus.

Stellenbeschreibung:
Start: asap

As a Bike Mechanic, you’ll be responsible for the complete repair and refurbishment of e-bikes, ensuring each one meets the highest quality standards before being delivered to customers. You’ll work with a dedicated and skilled team in a fully equipped workshop using state-of-the-art tools and diagnostic equipment.

Your Role

- Independently perform inspection, troubleshooting, spare parts selection, repair, and quality control on a wide variety of e-bikes.
- Prepare e-bikes for customer delivery and maintain the in-house fleet.
- Contribute to continuous improvement in repair processes and service quality.
- Support warehouse operations with ideas to optimize efficiency and workflow.

Your Qualifications

- 1–2 years of experience in bike or e-bike mechanics (2+ years for Senior Mechanic).
- Solid knowledge of electric bikes, their components, and diagnostic tools.
- Passion for quality, efficiency, and hands-on technical problem-solving.
- Comfort working independently and as part of a close-knit team.
- Fluency in English or  German

The Offer

- A permanent employment contract with a competitive monthly salary.
- Monday to Friday schedule – your weekends are always free.
- Opportunity to work with a huge variety of e-bikes, from almost-new to heavily used.
- Modern workshop environment with electric stands, high-end tools, and advanced diagnostic systems.
- Regular performance reviews every 6 months with promotion opportunities.
- A team of experienced mechanics who support your growth and share their expertise.
- A dynamic and supportive startup culture with real room for personal development and impact.

BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare more
Making a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.

- Successfully completed university studies, preferably with a Bachelor's Degree or higher in Business Administration, International Management, or a comparable field.

- Strong coordination skills with the ability to structure topics, proactively follow up, and independently manage multiple priorities.

jobs.description:
**The following challenges await you:** 

- You will join the newly established Corporate Development function as a key sparring partner, shaping the long-term strategic direction of Heraeus Convantics through 2035.
- From day one, you will engage with both CEOs and the Leadership Team on the questions that matter most: where to grow, where to focus, which new business fields to build, and how to position the company in a changing market environment.
- In this role, you will take topics end-to-end – from structuring and analyzing complex problems & trends to translating findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior leadership. Selected strategic initiatives will be delegated to you with full execution responsibility, so you can see your work translate into real outcomes.
- You will work across all five Business Lines, collaborate closely with leaders from across the organization, and engage with external partners as needed. Topics will range from new business field development and footprint decisions to portfolio choices and strategic M&A evaluations – with a future-back perspective focused on long-term value creation.
- Beyond your day-to-day work on strategic topics, you will help shape how the function operates from the ground up – defining methodologies and establishing Corporate Development as a high-impact contributor to the company’s long-term direction. For ambitious people with clear leadership ambitions, this is a role designed to build board strategic depth and open the path to future leadership responsibility.

Your Profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in business, economics, management, engineering, or a related field
- 3–5 years of professional experience, ideally with a foundation in strategy consulting, complemented by industry experience and/or corporate development exposure
- Proven track record on complex strategic projects with senior-management visibility – ideally including portfolio strategy, new business development, or transformation work
- High ownership mindset – comfortable taking topics from initial structuring all the way to actionable recommendations, with strong personal accountability
- Driven by curiosity – a genuine interest for Semiconductors, Datacom, Photonics, Materials, AI and emerging future trends, paired with the ability to quickly build expertise in unfamiliar topics and industries
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills – ability to structure ambiguity and translate insights into actionable recommendations
- Confident communicator – able to produce high-quality strategic content and engage credibly with senior stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
- Leadership ambition – this role offers a clear development path for those who want to grow into a broader scope
- Comfortable working across cultures, functions and global locations
- Business-fluent in English, German is a strong plus

What you can look forward to at Heraeus Covantics:

- Attractive compensation – in addition to a competitive salary package, you’ll benefit from comprehensive benefits offered by a responsible family-owned company
- Flexible time off – 30 days of annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company holidays on long weekends and between Christmas and New Year’s), special leave for special occasions, and a lifetime working time account for paid time off (e.g., early retirement)
- Sustainability & social commitment – sustainability as an integral part of the corporate strategy, as well as targeted support for educational, family, and scientific initiatives through our own foundations
- Modern workplace – ergonomic workspace in an open-plan office with modern equipment, a laptop of your choice, two additional monitors, an iPhone (also for personal use), and height-adjustable desks
- Additional benefits – subsidies for public transportation, discounts at numerous (online) stores, an on-site medical service with comprehensive preventive health checkups, sports programs, and an employee cafeteria with meals freshly prepared daily

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Development Manager – Distribution Partners Germany, EMEA Partner Organization (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.

The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.

As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.

Key job responsibilities
Partner Management & Strategy
• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.
• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.
• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.
• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.

Revenue & Performance Management
• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.
• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.
• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.
• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.
• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.

Program Design & Execution
• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs.
.
• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.

Enablement & Ecosystem Growth
• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.
• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.
• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.

About the team
The Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background
- German and English business fluent
- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems
- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation
- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability
- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisations

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)
- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience
- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)
- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement
- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch
- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscape

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

Our tax team of six, led by our Head of Tax, covers the tax matters of all group companies worldwide. To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.

Tasks

- Support in preparing and maintaining our transfer pricing documentation (Master File, Local Files, CbCR), including functional and risk analyses.

- Sound knowledge of German corporate income tax law; knowledge of international tax law is desirable.
- Initial exposure to transfer pricing, or a clear interest in building expertise in this area.
- Experience with SAP and common tax software, along with very good Excel skills.
- Structured and independent way of working, and enjoyment of working with different business functions.
- Business-fluent German and good English language skills.

Benefits

- Hybrid working model.
- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.

- Modern office space with very good transport connections.
- Various employee discounts for activities and products.
- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
- Numerous training and development opportunities.
